ashwinsathian-humanize-writing-skill-roo.description: Use when drafting prose of a paragraph or more for a human reader (docs, READMEs, reports, emails, blog posts, cover letters, release notes, PR descriptions, commit bodies, long explanations in chat), or when asked to humanize text or make it sound less AI-generated, robotic, or like slop. Not for proofreading a person's own writing or for evading AI detectors.
